name: Pix Transmission Ltd
about: PIX Transmissions Ltd. is the leading manufacturer of Belts and related mechanical Power Transmission products in India. The Company features state-of-the-art Belt manufacturing units as well as an ultra-sophisticated, automated Rubber Mixing facility. [1]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio
The product portfolio includes industrial belts, agricultural belts, lawn & garden belts, automotive belts, hi-power rated belts, power-ware products, and various accessories. [1] 
The company has a large number of SKUs and sells more than 80% of the products under its own Brand Name and largely in after sales market.
